correctness.rationale: Pointwise Jacobian has zero trace, zero determinant and zero squared-trace, hence cube zero. Periodic recurrence reduces heights to squared pairwise differences of three real polynomial values, forcing the degenerate triangle equality. Quadratic interpolation proves all permitted triples, and reversing the three distinct heights gives disjoint cycles. Exact symbolic and rational checks reproduced these identities.
